description: This file defines the class FeedLogicBase, which provides base logic for feed handling in the SuiteCRM module, including methods to push feed, install, and remove hooks related to the feed functionality.

classes.name: FeedLogicBase
classes.description: A base class for feed logic handling in the SuiteCRM module, providing methods to push feeds and manage hooks.

methods.name: pushFeed

methods.name: installHook

methods.name: removeHook
methods.description: Removes a previously installed logic hook for the 'before_save' event.
